I1.location: main, p. 2 (journal p. 10036), Section 2.3 Hydrogen Uptake Measurements

I2.quote: Hydrogen sorption isotherm of the mesoporous carbon monolith, measured by gravimetric analysis with an IGA at -196 °C over the pressure range 0-20 bar, is shown in Figure 7A.

I3.quote: The hydrogen uptake capacity of the mesoporous carbon monolith (at -196 °C and 20 bar) is ca. 3.4 wt %.

I4.quote: mesostructural ordering is observed in the carbon monolith, which has surface area and pore volume of 1090 m2/g and 0.75 cm3/g, respectively.

I5.quote: We report on the use of a chemical vapor deposition to nanocast ordered mesoporous carbon monoliths using mesoporous silica monoliths as template.

notes: Two carbon sorbents measured gravimetrically (IGA, -196 °C, 0-20 bar, buoyancy-corrected): CVD-nanocast mesoporous carbon monolith (Fig. 7A) and powdered CMK-3 (Fig. 7B, surface area 1404 m2/g, p. 4-5). Carbon majority supported by TGA: residual mass above 700 °C less than 1 wt % (p. 2, Section 3.1). Surface area method BET, P/P0 0.05-0.2, N2 at -196 °C (p. 2, Section 2.2).
